summary: Fangdd Network Group Ltd., a China-based property technology company, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, reporting first-half 2026 unaudited financial results. Revenue declined 43.1% year-over-year to RMB115.7 million, net loss was RMB34.5 million, and closed-loop GMV fell 30.8% to RMB5.5 billion. The CEO attributed declines to China's real estate market downturn but highlighted AI-driven innovation. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event, M&A, or strategic action. Watch for continued operational performance and any future strategic repositioning given persistent market weakness.
